== Super Volunteer and lead photo (2026-10-25) ==
* "Super Vol" spelled out as Super Volunteer at Bill's request. Decipher's own DecipherCon 1999 captions use both forms for the same role: [[Trevor Hinkley]] is "Super Vol" in sun13 and "Super-volunteer" in fri22 (refs on the article).
* Lead photo [[:File:Kim Burns DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] is a crop of Decipher's fri26 photo (400×300 original, so the crop is 78×110). The uncropped original stays in Photographs. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 01:40, 26 October 2026 (UTC)
